versions.localizedDescription:
## Erosion-CN v0.9.2

### What's New / 更新内容
1. **设置页生态联动 & 统一致谢（Settings Refresh & Ecosystem Links）**
   - Removed the separate "Special Thanks" section and unified all upstream authors and open-source references under **Credits & Open-Source References (`致谢与开源参考`)**.
   - Added **More Open-Source Projects (Kianuni)** section inside Settings showcasing **[AppleFlow](https://github.com/Kianuni/AppleFlow)**, **[WQGuard](https://github.com/Kianuni/WQGuard)**, **[Camlo](https://github.com/Kianuni/Camlo)**, and **[Enkard](https://github.com/Kianuni/Enkard)** with full EN/ZH localization.
2. **内置分流导出同步 `AppleFlow v1.0.1`（Synced Built-in Routing Export）**
   - Added missing PCC blind-signature domains (`*.issuer.apple.com`, `ropes.apple.com`) to prevent `PrivateCloudComputeError Code=32033` when using the in-app exported Surge `.sgmodule` or Stash `.stoverride`.
   - Replaced overly broad `google.com` / `googleapis.com` / `gstatic.com` suffixes with targeted production domains (`lens.google.com`, `gemini.google.com`, `chatgpt.livekit.cloud`, `sora.com`, `claudeusercontent.com`, etc.).

### Install / 下载安装
- **SideStore / AltStore / Feather 官方源**：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/main/apps.json`
- **直接下载安装包**：下方附件 `Erosion_v0.9.2_Bilingual.ipa`（单包内置中英双语，安装时请保留 App Group 权限）。
